## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `html2md` command is a format conversion utility that transforms HTML files into Markdown format. This command is part of Contexter's dual-format ecosystem, enabling bidirectional conversion between HTML and Markdown context files.

For converting Markdown to HTML, see [md2html](/ray0404/Contexter/5.4.2-md2html). For building context files directly in either format, see [buildcontext](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.1-buildcontext) and [buildcontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.2-buildcontexthtml).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md1-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L1-L61) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L54)

---

## Overviewsvg image

The `html2md` command converts any HTML file to Markdown format, with special support for Contexter's HTML context file structure. The conversion preserves code blocks, file metadata, and project structure information embedded in the HTML format.

**Key Features:**

- Converts HTML context files to Markdown context files
- Preserves code syntax and language identifiers
- Maintains file path metadata from `data-path` attributes
- Handles both text content and binary file markers
- Compatible with general HTML to Markdown conversion

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md34-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L34-L35) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L48-L48)

---

## Conversion Processsvg image

### HTML Parsing Strategysvg image

The `html2md` command leverages `contexter_utils.parse_html_constructor()` to parse Contexter-specific HTML structures:

**Diagram: HTML to Markdown Conversion Pipeline**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py111-129](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L111-L129)

### HTML Element Mappingsvg image

The conversion process recognizes and transforms these HTML structures:

| HTML Structure | Attributes | Markdown Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<div class="file-container">` | `data-path="path/to/file.py"` | `--- FILE: path/to/file.py ---` |
| `<div class="highlight"><pre>` | Contains code content | ````` ````language\ncode\n```` ````` |
| `<div class="skipped-container">` | `data-path="path/to/binary"` | `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): path/to/binary ---` |
| `<div class="tree-container">` | Contains directory tree | `# File Tree\n...\n` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py119-128](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L119-L128)

### Language Detectionsvg image

For code blocks, the conversion process:

1. Extracts the file path from `data-path` attribute
2. Infers language using `get_language_from_path()` from [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py218-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L218-L236)
3. Applies appropriate language identifier to Markdown code fence

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py218-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L218-L236)

## Integration with Contexter Ecosystemsvg image

### Bidirectional Conversionsvg image

The `html2md` command forms a conversion pair with `md2html`:

**Diagram: Format Conversion in Contexter Ecosystem**

### Command Flow Patternssvg image

Common patterns using `html2md`:

| Pattern | Commands | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTML → Markdown → Sanitize | `html2md`, `sanitizecontext` | Fix AI-generated HTML output |
| HTML → Markdown → Update | `html2md`, `smartupdate` | Use efficient Markdown updates |
| Rebuild → Convert → Archive | `reconstructorhtml`, `html2md` | Normalize format for storage |
| Convert → Patch → Convert | `html2md`, `updatecontext`, `md2html` | Cross-format version management |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md20-36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L20-L36)

## Technical Implementation Detailssvg image

### Dependenciessvg image

The `html2md` module relies on:

1. **beautifulsoup4**: HTML parsing and DOM traversal

   - Used by `parse_html_constructor()` in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py115-116](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L115-L116)
   - Finds elements by class: `file-container`, `skipped-container`
2. **markdownify**: HTML to Markdown conversion

   - Handles general HTML elements (paragraphs, headers, links)
   - Preserves code block structure
3. **contexter\_utils**: Shared utility functions

   - `parse_html_constructor()`: Extracts file paths and contents
   - `get_language_from_path()`: Determines syntax highlighting language

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py12](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L12-L12) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py218-236](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L218-L236)

## Output Format Specificationsvg image

### Markdown Context Structuresvg image

The `html2md` command generates Markdown files following this structure:

--- SKIPPED (BINARY): assets/logo.png ---

--- FILE: src/utils.py ---

```px-2
### Header Format Rules

| Element | Format | Example |
|---------|--------|---------|
| Text file header | `--- FILE: <path> ---` | `--- FILE: src/app.py ---` |
| Binary file header | `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): <path> ---` | `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): image.png ---` |
| Code fence start | ` ````<language>` | ` ````python` |
| Code fence end | ` ```` ` | ` ```` ` |

**Sources:** <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L76-L108" min=76 max=108 file-path="contexter_utils.py">Hii</FileRef>

## Limitations and Considerations

### Format Fidelity

1. **HTML-specific Formatting**: Some HTML styling (colors, fonts) may be lost
2. **Syntax Highlighting**: Preserved via language identifiers, not inline styles
3. **Comment Preservation**: HTML comments are not typically converted to Markdown comments

### Cross-Format Compatibility

When converting between formats repeatedly:

```bash
# Information may degrade with multiple conversions
buildcontext project/ original.md
md2html original.md intermediate.html
html2md intermediate.html recovered.md
```

**Recommendation**: Minimize conversion cycles. Choose one primary format and convert only when necessary.

### Character Encodingsvg image

- Both input HTML and output Markdown use UTF-8 encoding
- Special characters in file paths must be properly escaped
- Binary file markers prevent content corruption

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py78](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L78-L78) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py115](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L115-L115)
